video_title: Gilbert Arenas says LeBron is 6'10, had no BAG and just OUTSMARTED the ENTIRE NBA 😂

quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's early career position and playing style
quotes.excerpt: He came in the league as a shooting guard, he guarding me.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Allen
text_blocks.text: Take me through those LeBron battles. Was he everything that was advertised?

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: When we first played him, he was at the shooting guard. He came in the league as a shooting guard, he guarding me. I think Andre Miller left. I forget who the point guard was that was there first, but it was him, Darius Miles. They had a point guard, but he came in as the shooting guard because Ricky Davis was the three, Darius Miles was the boozer. That was the lineup. He was bigger, stronger, faster. We could see he could do his thing.

quotes.social_post: Tony Allen recalls facing a young LeBron James when he first entered the league as a shooting guard. He was bigger stronger and faster than everyone else on the floor from day one.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's early scouting and high-level basketball IQ
quotes.excerpt: He's watching all sports. He's got different playoff games, high school, tennis. He's really flicking through.
quotes.quote: When we played him in the playoffs, you got Rich Paul and them, Larry Hughes over there, so we're going to the crib, gambling. So in real time, I'm looking to see what everybody on. He's got the four TVs with the Tivo boxes. He's watching all sports. He's got different playoff games, high school, tennis. I'm just sitting there like he's really flicking through, and then got a little notebook, just writing plays down. He's got our stuff on there too. I'm sitting here like, this motherfucker is early watching tape like that. I was like, hey man, this little motherfucker might be smarter than we think. We need to be careful with him.
quotes.social_post: Gilbert Arenas remembers realizing LeBron James was different early on after seeing him obsessively studying game tape and writing down plays in a notebook. He knew then that LeBron might be smarter than everyone thought.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's ability to manipulate the game without complex moves
quotes.excerpt: He didn't have no move, he didn't have no crossover, he didn't have no behind the back.
quotes.quote: I didn't pick it up until we lost the series. We played them again the next year. I'm sitting on the bench and it was towards the end of the first, he looked at the bench and said, 'I'm out.' And then coach is like, 'Zydrunas Ilgauskas.' As soon as Zydrunas Ilgauskas goes, he's watching. I look down, motherfucker big man coming out. Our coach looked, 'Oh shit, go get Brendan Haywood.' He hit the rim, him and Larry Hughes just attacking. He was playing coy at the beginning, then he turns it on. As soon as they took Brendan Haywood out, him and Larry just attacked the basket. I told coach, 'Hey man, I don't think this motherfucker 6'8 no more, dog.' He was like, 'What do you mean?' I said, 'Kobe is 6'8 and he's looking over that motherfucker. I said Antoine is 6'9, I said put Jared on him. Jared 6'10, Jared him and that motherfucker eye to eye.' He grew. They need to update that shit, dog. It's all fucked up. We playing 6'8 to get 6'8 and he all the damn near 6'10 out here. The way he manipulated the game, no move. He didn't have no move, he didn't have no crossover, he didn't have no behind the back. It was just freight train, understood footwork, understood the game, understood what people were.
quotes.social_post: Gilbert Arenas claims LeBron James was already 6 foot 10 early in his career and manipulated the game with pure strength rather than complex moves. He says LeBron was just a freight train.
